concept.title: Beacons over Frost Peaks
concept.logline: On snowbound, tense Ashsalgard, you unravel the mechanisms to recover the ember stones and restore the Avalanche Watch.
concept.source_prompt: Frost Peaks. snow mountain mountains peaks puzzle Beacon circuit
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Hearth Lodge and becomes the one who brings the Avalanche Watch back to life.

characters.name: Warden Ember
characters.description: Waits in Hearth Lodge and knows why the Avalanche Watch fell silent.

characters.name: Kai the Tracker
characters.description: Follows you from Hearth Lodge and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Glacier Warden
characters.description: A glacier warden that never leaves its post, but lunges at anyone who gets close.

characters.name: Tobin the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Ashsalgard for anything shiny.

characters.name: Snow Hare
characters.description: A harmless snow hare that bolts if you come too close.

actions.value: On snowbound, tense Ashsalgard, you unravel the mechanisms to recover the ember stones and restore the Avalanche Watch.
Light the beacons in order: Aurora Shrine → Pine Hollow → Trapper Camp, then the Avalanche Watch.
Next in the circuit: the Aurora Shrine.
The Aurora Shrine flares; its beam points toward the Pine Hollow.
Next in the circuit: the Pine Hollow.
The Pine Hollow flares; its beam points toward the Trapper Camp.
The circuit runs Aurora Shrine → Pine Hollow → Trapper Camp.
Next in the circuit: the Trapper Camp.
The circuit is closed. The Avalanche Watch answers.
The circuit runs Aurora Shrine → Pine Hollow → Trapper Camp.
Every beacon burns. Beacons over Frost Peaks is lit again.
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Warden Ember
nodes.text: So you've come to Hearth Lodge at last. I am Warden Ember. On snowbound, tense Ashsalgard, you unravel the mechanisms to recover the ember stones and restore the Avalanche Watch.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Warden Ember
nodes.text: Back again. Hearth Lodge is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Warden Ember
nodes.text: Go to Trapper Camp, then Pine Hollow. Whatever still remembers Beacons over Frost Peaks is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Warden Ember
nodes.text: They say Hearth Lodge was built on what was left of an older place. Harsh, even then. Ask the stones and they won't argue.

nodes.speaker: Warden Ember
nodes.text: Trapper Camp: Trapper Camp: a camp on the way out from Hearth Lodge.

nodes.speaker: Warden Ember
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Beacons over Frost Peaks back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Warden Ember
nodes.text: Pine Hollow: Pine Hollow: a grove on the way out from Hearth Lodge.

nodes.speaker: Kai the Tracker
nodes.text: Kai the Tracker circles your feet, then looks toward Trapper Camp as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Kai the Tracker
nodes.text: Kai the Tracker keeps close and glances back at Hearth Lodge.

nodes.speaker: Kai the Tracker
nodes.text: It turns toward Trapper Camp. Trapper Camp: a camp on the way out from Hearth Lodge.

nodes.speaker: Glacier Warden
nodes.text: Halt. Glacier Warden, of the watch at Hearth Lodge. Keep to the paths out there.

nodes.speaker: Glacier Warden
nodes.text: Still in one piece? Good. Keep it that way.

nodes.speaker: Glacier Warden
nodes.text: Snow sweeping the exposed ground around the Avalanche Watch. Worst near Trapper Camp.

nodes.speaker: Tobin the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Hearth Lodge. Tobin the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Tobin the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Beacons over Frost Peaks that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Tobin the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Pine Hollow after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Snow Hare
nodes.text: The snow hare freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
